The short circuit MVA for one alternator is:  
\[
\text{Short circuit MVA} = \frac{\text{Base MVA}}{\text{Subtransient reactance (p.u.)}} = \frac{20}{0.16} = 125 \text{ MVA}
\]  

For four identical alternators in parallel, the total short circuit MVA is:  
\[
4 \times 125 = 500 \text{ MVA}
\]  

Final answer: (A)
